headline: Raspberry Pi hikes 16GB Pi 5 price to $385 amid memory crunch
summary: The price of the 16GB Raspberry Pi 5 rose to $385, more than triple its original launch price, as a memory chip shortage drives new hikes. The increase, which adds $80 to the previous price, comes barely a month after the last round of price increases.
